fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it, making each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pungent Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a stinking drop that deals 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reek Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Last Warning
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 12 damage. Once every 45 seconds.
